case: law7: an agents section mounts the agent plane
_comment: Law 7's control: the same binary with the `agents:` section serves the agent admin paths, lists the section as an overlay section, and answers its door as a plane door (RFC 6750) to an unauthenticated caller.

files.config.yaml:
listen: "127.0.0.1:{data_port}"
admin_listen: "127.0.0.1:{admin_port}"
advanced:
  allow_destinations: ["127.0.0.1"]
store: {module: memory}
public_url: "http://127.0.0.1:{data_port}"
identity-providers:
  admin-tokens:
    module: admin-tokens
    token: { env: BUSBAR_ADMIN_TOKEN }
auth:
  chain: [keys]
  signing_key: { file: "{signing_key_file}" }
  admin_auth: [admin-tokens]
providers:
  mock:
    api_key: { env: MOCK_KEY }
models:
  test-model:
    provider: mock
agents:
  a1: { url: "https://a.example/card", pin: { mechanism: unpinned } }
files.providers.yaml:
mock:
  protocol: anthropic
  base_url: "http://127.0.0.1:9"
  api_key_env: MOCK_KEY
